directive.quote: Every engine job of the old Worker's rust-engine backlog rows works on the new engine, one to one or better.

preserve: every run the account holds erased one bounded page at a time, PAGE = 20, in id order after a cursor its caller keeps, so an erasure cut off part way resumes where it stopped
erasing a run twice is the same erasure
erasure takes the run's receipt, input digest and answer; only the mark that it was erased stays
a retry of an erased run's request key answers erased, 410, and never runs or sends again
the erasure runs only inside the account's own current deletion
allowed_deltas: the per-sign-in tool-run gates and their run lists, and one Durable Object per run, are dropped (worker-host): every run of an account is in the one receipts journal under its state folder, so the walk is that journal's own page and each run is one compare-and-set mark
checkAccountErasure before and after each page is the account deletion's own check of its kept row, around every step

the receipts journal keeps replaced versions in its change history and its owner has no function that removes them without SQL outside src/storage; the current receipt is replaced at once and the history leaves with the account's state folder
banned_substitutions: an erased run run again under its request key
a run read back after its erasure
